nodes.question: Does the edited image show any visible progress toward stuffing the paper into the cup, such as the paper entering or being positioned within the cup opening?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the edited image visibly shows the paper entering or positioned within the cup as an attempt, even if stuffing is incomplete. Fail if it clearly shows no such progress, such as paper held away from the cup. Unknown if the cup, paper, or their spatial relation cannot be determined.
nodes.binding: Assess only the edited image for visible progress toward the requested action of stuffing the paper into the cup. Mere proximity, contact with the rim, or an unrelated object does not establish progress; do not require completed stuffing for a pass.

nodes.question: Does the edited image clearly show the paper stuffed inside the cup, rather than merely near or on its rim?
nodes.criteria: Pass only if the paper is visibly inside the cup and its placement shows it has been stuffed into it. Fail if the image clearly shows it is not stuffed inside. Unknown if visibility or ambiguity prevents deciding whether this completed relation is shown.
nodes.binding: Assess the edited image for completed stuffing of the paper into the cup. Do not infer completion from proximity, rim contact, or a pass on the progress check.

nodes.criteria: Report complete only when s2 passes. Report partial when s1 passes but s2 does not pass, including when s2 is unknown: progress is evidenced and completion is not established. Report absent when s1 fails. If s1 is unknown, report unknown; do not infer absence or progress.

program.checker_template:
Execute ONE saved check. Return status, evidence, confidence (0 to 1 or null), and used_dependency_ids. You receive no reference label or optimizer feedback. Do not predict what the optimizer wants.
Support checks receive source and edited images. Inspect only the saved visual proposition and binding. When dependencies are supplied, use those ancestor observations as context and investigate the more specific proposition yourself; do not simply repeat the parent answer. Use pass/fail/unknown. A pass on a broad parent does not imply a nested check passes. Known negative evidence is usable; uncertain or missing evidence is unknown. Do not award requested completion credit to supporting facts.
The requested fulfillment readout receives NO images. Use ALL and ONLY saved support observations, the original instruction, rubric and saved composition criteria. Use complete/partial/absent/unknown. Mere texture or object presence must not silently establish whole-image conversion or a requested spatial relation. Known progress plus evidenced incompleteness may be partial; absence means no requested progress. Missing necessary evidence is unknown, never a fabricated failure or completion. Do not infer new visual facts.
used_dependency_ids must name every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in saved order (empty when none). Confidence is self-report, not calibrated correctness.
